findings.location: Lines 44-46, the icon-delete div containing a trash icon

findings.location: Lines 47-57, the wizard-steps section with three step divs
findings.violation: The CSS order property visually reorders the steps as 1-2-3, but the DOM order is 3-2-1 (reversed). Screen reader users and keyboard navigators will encounter the steps in reverse logical order compared to what sighted users see visually, creating confusion about the sequence.
